description: Staking HYPE directly with a validator: the active set ranked by predicted APR, with each one's commission, uptime and share of stake, and jailed validators named but excluded. This is what the network pays before any liquid staking wrapper takes its cut, so it is the benchmark every kHYPE or stHYPE rate should be judged against — those live in hyperevm_yields. Read-only, public data, no API key.

include_inactive.description: Include jailed and inactive validators. Default false.
